notes: Fully-loaded $/ton (indoor unit + vertical bore loop + plumbing tie-in). Industry consolidates indoor+loop into single per-ton figure - HomeGuide 2026: $3500-$5500/ton typical; Bryant 2026: up to $11700/ton premium. 3-ton typical $10500-$19500. https://homeguide.com/costs/geothermal-heat-pump-cost
Fully-loaded $/ton with horizontal trench loop (needs ~1 acre yard). Cheaper than vertical because trenching displaces drilling. https://www.angi.com/articles/geothermal-heating-and-cooling-cost.htm
Fully-loaded $/ton with pond/lake loop. Requires pond at least 8ft deep year-round. Cheapest loop when available.
Fully-loaded $/ton with open-loop well + discharge. Restricted in many jurisdictions; well-fouling risk.
